builtBy: Research by hand, 2026-11-13 (the 41 SCVAL and BVAL schools) and 2026-11-14 (the 19 WCAL and WBAL schools, and the name searches the first round did not finish): the club records from each club's own website; the ties from the players' Hudl, NCSA, SportsRecruits and MaxPreps career pages, the clubs' own rosters, Prep Dig's and PrepVolleyball's player pages, school and local papers and one college's signing release. Every Hudl and NCSA page was re-read by a second reader; no script rebuilds this file.
notes: The youth volleyball clubs players on the 60 tracked varsity rosters (the SCVAL, BVAL, WCAL and WBAL) are tied to, and the other girls' clubs found in and around Santa Clara County. The linking rule is field hockey's (README, "Clubs"), with one change of place: a public page must name the player and a volleyball or beach volleyball club, and either name the player's high school, or give a class year equal to the roster's along with a hometown in the school's own area (its city or a neighbouring one). A name alone never counts, a class year that disagrees with the roster rules a match out, and social media is never a source.

Club records: the candidate list was the NCVA 2025-26 Girls Power League points tables for 15s to 18s (84 club codes; ncva.com has no public club directory), then every club a player's own page names. Each record was written from the club's own site. South Bay and Peninsula clubs were looked for; the East Bay, Central Coast, San Francisco and Marin records are clubs a player is tied to or that were met on the way, and those areas were not searched for every club. The Edge Volleyball Club is an Illinois club one Fremont player's Hudl page lists (region elsewhere).

No record, so no tie shown, although a player's page names the club: Apex Volleyball Club (Pioneer players' NCSA, SportsRecruits and Prep Dig pages; it plays NCVA events, but no site or city was found on either day), Frisco Bay Volleyball Club (one Mercy Burlingame player's NCSA page; no club of the name could be identified), Titans (one Palo Alto player's NCSA line), J5 Beach Volleyball and Golden Gate Beach Volleyball (one player each), BRX and Bay Area Eagles (one MaxPreps career page each), and Hudl organizations that may not be clubs (Titans Athletics, Global Challenge). Absolute, Club 415, Rage Westside, SF Juniors and Kamikaze, without a record after the 2026-11-13 round, have one now, each from its own site. NCVA Power League clubs met on no player's page whose sites were not found still have no record (among them SPVC, VVA, FPVC, ITVC, Spark, Samba, Amplify, Cloud, Lakas, Vibe, Endline, Xceleration and Paye's Place).

Status. current: a source from the 2025-26 or 2026-27 club season (the club's own 2026-27 roster, a Hudl or NCSA entry for 2026 or later, a page dated 2026, a MaxPreps career entry joined or edited in 2026). past: a Hudl or NCSA entry that ends in 2024 or earlier, or a source that says she left. unknown: everything else, such as a Hudl entry for 2025 (which may be the 2024-25 or the 2025-26 club season) or an undated club list. A Hudl year range is partly a team's lifespan on Hudl, so a past tie's year is approximate. An NCSA entry's year is the club season's end (2027 is 2026-27); a later year is a team's class label and dates nothing. A news story's date does not date a club it mentions (a profile may tell of a club she left), so a story never makes a tie current.

Hudl ties: the team list of each linked Hudl profile, which is on the school's own volleyball team and so names the school. One tie per club, quoting the latest entry's team name, organization, sport and years (data fields of the page, joined with ' / '). Left out: coaches' accounts, entries that end before the player's sixth grade, and organizations that are schools. Each list was read twice, by the sweep and by the refuter, and only entries in both reads are used.

Club rosters give names only (Mountain View Volleyball Club's 2026-27 LeagueApps rosters, Vision's 2025-26 teams page, Academy's SportsRecruits list, Legend's team pages), so a roster match is a tie only where a second page names the player with the same club and her school: 45 ties were completed that way and about 60 exact-name matches were left out. The Mountain View rosters are read at the cited address with '&ngmp_2023_iframe_transition=1' added, which is what the page's own frame loads.

Round of 2026-11-14: the 19 WCAL and WBAL schools (307 varsity rows) by every method of the first round (Hudl team rosters, NCSA, a SportsRecruits address probe, MaxPreps career pages, Prep Dig, PrepVolleyball), NCSA read through a headless browser this time; and, for all 60 schools, NCSA name searches for every named row, Prep Dig and PrepVolleyball for every junior, senior and ungraded row, and web searches for every senior. A tie the first round already had gained the new source, its basis saying so ('Round of 2026-11-14'). Prep Dig pages whose club link goes to a Vision club in another state are not used. NCSA spellings of a club (Pandas Volleyball Club, Panda VBC, MHVC) are mapped to the club's record.
JV players' club ties were not listed until 2026-11-27; since then a JV row's tie is served on its JV row, as in the other builds (the NCVA rosters list JV players: below).

League rosters, 2026-11-27 (README, "Club rosters in the other sports"): the public team rosters of the NCVA Girls Power League, read from TM2Sign's public API into data/volleyball/club-rosters.json (pnpm fetch-club-rosters:volleyball: the 2026 league's 13s-17s, the 2025-26 club season, 579 rosters with players; the 2027 league's 14s-18s, 42 of 594 posted so far), compared with every varsity and JV row by pnpm compare-club-rosters:volleyball. A roster gives a name only: a row matches when its class year is one the team's age group admits (USA Volleyball's July 1 age definition, California's September 1 cutoff), no other tracked school has the name, every agreeing roster that season is at one club, and the club is based in San Francisco, the Peninsula, the South Bay or the Central Coast. 237 new ties rest on a roster alone (medium, current for the club season the roster is for); 169 ties other pages had already made gain the roster and read current. Each cited roster was read again live the same day and lists the player. Not linked: Ellie Chu (Milpitas), Madison Miller (Sobrato) and Kitana Manalo (Notre Dame San Jose), whose names are on another club's roster too; 22 matches at clubs away from the schools (City Beach in Fremont, Absolute in San Rafael, Union Volleyball Academy), and the rows the rule leaves (a name at two schools, no grade, a class year the age group does not admit, a club with no record).

2026-11-27, on the owner's pointer: Archbishop Mitty's Melina Gklaros-Stavropoulos to Mountain View Volleyball Club (her Prep Dig page naming school and club, and MVVC G 14 Red's 2026 Power League roster). MaxPreps misspells her surname ('Gklaros-Stavropolous'), so the kept-roster comparison had not matched her; the site respells it since the same day (lib/sources/person-name.ts NAME_SPELLINGS, the owner's correction). On the owner's word the same day: Saint Francis' Victoria Tuipulotu to Union Volleyball Academy (current; her club Hudl profile and UVA 17 Lynda's 2026 Power League roster) and Red Rock (earlier; Red Rock 15 Quinn on the 2024 Power League). A sweep of MaxPreps misspellings then corrected eleven more names in lib/sources/person-name.ts NAME_SPELLINGS; with Saratoga's Dhrishti Shah and SHC's Caylee and Chelsie Chin spelled right, the kept rosters matched them (Red Rock; SF Tremors), and Mitty's Thaïs Ettori's Vision tie gained its roster.

2026-11-27, the owner's decision: for volleyball a club in the East Bay is near enough to the schools (VOLLEYBALL_LOCAL_REGIONS, lib/players/club-rosters.ts; rule 5 of the league-roster rule). The kept NCVA rosters then matched 11 more players at City Beach (Fremont) and Union Volleyball Academy: Milpitas' Katie Cao, MacDonald's Makayla and Ava Tacci and Maya Castro, Branham's Valeriya Tomkiv and Emily Lloyd, Westmont's Annalee Dang, Sobrato's Ashley Nguyen (UVA), Lincoln's Camila Zaldaña, Saint Francis' Jianna Llaneza (UVA) and Presentation's Faith Hau, each on a roster alone (medium, current for 2025-26); Teagan Cummings', Kenley Christensen's, Annabelle Gonzales' and Cierra Huynh's City Beach ties gain the roster. Each roster read again live. On a second decision the same day Marin counts too: Absolute (San Rafael) then matched SHC's Sophia Fong, SI's Cecilia Hecker and Menlo's Jamie Johnson (new, medium), and Britt Melinauskas', Eileen Pfeffer's, Neve Harlan's and Giulia McManigal's Absolute ties gain the roster.

2026-11-27, on the owner's request, the three names the comparison had left on two clubs' rosters: Milpitas' Ellie Chu to Vision and Sobrato's Madison Miller to North Coast (the other roster of each name is a team two age groups younger, another player), and Notre Dame San Jose's Kitana Manalo to Tyrants as an earlier club (2025-26): the 2027 Power League lists her on SBND Elite (Sunny Ball ND Elite, her school's volleyball coach's program, with two NDSJ teammates), a club with no record here, its site not found.

Other forms of a name, 2026-11-28 (owner decision: tie a player a club roster lists under another form of the name, when everything else agrees; a class year one off is accepted when the player is very likely the same). The league-roster rule was run with each row's first name in its other forms (isAnotherFormOf in lib/players/club-rosters.ts), each roster source naming the roster's spelling in `rosterName`. New ties (medium, current, the 2026 Power League): Giudi Cusmano (Prospect, Tropical Touch, Giuditta), Alex Fair (Menlo, ENCORE, Alexandra), Giana Brooks (Mercy Burlingame, NorStar, Gianna), Dani Pokorny (Presentation, Legend, Danielle), Bella Jansen-Olliges (Sacred Heart Prep, ENCORE, Isabella), and on JV Emerella Wang (Homestead, Red Rock, Emerelle), Alex Ferris (Homestead, Panda, Alexandra), Stella Polyzos (Sacred Heart Cathedral, Slainte, Estelle) and Camila Colorado (Notre Dame Belmont, NorStar, Camilla). Ten ties other pages had made gain the roster: Emme Liao (NorStar), Kat Minkevich, Brooklyn Gipson and Abby Cardenas (Vision), Gabi Legault (Tropical Touch), Gabriella Evans (North Coast), Bella Flynn (City Beach), Juli Pierre (Academy), Alex Dongnguyen (Red Rock) and Izzy Saavedra (SF Tremors, a 16s team a year above her class). Left out: Mia Wang (Monta Vista; Panda's Miaoqi Wang) and Izabella Martinez (Eastside; Kalani's Isabella Martinez), common names with nothing else behind them. Every cited roster was re-read live the same day.
